data.name: Mehdi
data.gender_notes: Mehdi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehdi is an Arabic name that means 'guided one' or 'rightly guided'. It is a title given to the prophesied redeemer in Islamic eschatology. The name Mehdi carries the meaning “Guided One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehdi usually hope their child will grow to embody guided one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mehdi is believed to be the guided one who will bring peace and justice to the world.
data.etymology: Mehdi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guided One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehdi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مہدی
in_arabic.meaning: أفضل الأئمة والخلفاء الذين يأتي بعد المهدي
in_arabic.long_meaning: المهدي هو خاتم الأئمة والخلفاء في الإسلام، ويعتبر أفضل الخلفاء بعد النبي محمد، يأتي المهدي بعد الفتنة الكبرى، ويقود المسلمين إلى الانتصار وتنظيم المجتمع المسلم، يعتبر المهدي وسيلة لتطهير الإسلام من الريبة والخيرية، ويتميّز بسمو وجوده ووجوده، ويعتبره المسلمون خير الأئمة

in_urdu.name: مهدی

in_english.name: Mehdi
in_english.meaning: The awaited savior and the last of the twelve Imams in Shia Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Mehdi is the awaited savior and the last of the twelve Imams in Shia Islam. He is believed to be the twelve imams, and the last one who will come to guide and save the Muslim community. Mehdi is said to be the one who will bring about a golden age of peace and prosperity, and will be the leader of the Muslim community in the end times. He is also believed to be the one who will fulfill the prophecies of the Prophet Muhammad and bring about the final victory of Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The term Mehdi holds great significance in Islamic culture and is inseparable from the expectations and hopes of the Muslim community. The awaited arrival of Mehdi is an integral part of Islamic eschatology. His coming is prophesied to bring peace, justice, and prosperity to the world. The anticipation of Mehdi's arrival has been a source of comfort for Muslims throughout history, especially during times of hardship, conflict, or political turmoil. The expectation of Mehdi's arrival is shared by Muslims around the world, and his name is celebrated with joy and hope during various religious gatherings and festivals.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mehdi is rooted in its promise of guidance for the lost and the oppressed. As a restorer of righteousness, Mehdi is considered a divine intervention that will put the world back on the path of God's will. The name Mehdi is often associated with the practice of seeking spiritual enlightenment and guidance in everyday life, serving as a reminder of the importance of following the Qur'anic teachings and staying steadfast in faith. Therefore, the name Mehdi carries a profound spiritual meaning for Muslims, symbolizing their unwavering commitment to seeking guidance from God and striving for a more just and peaceful world.
